_metadata.note: Create the Slack app from this manifest (api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From a manifest). Socket Mode app: no request URLs. Requests a single bot scope (chat:write) to keep admin approval simple; the bot does not self-join, so invite it to the approval channel manually and set its ID in config/admins.yaml. See docs/03-deployment.md.

display_information.name: OpenShell Admin
display_information.description: Approve or reject OpenShell sandbox network-egress policy changes from Slack.
